title: First General Census of the Russian Empire, 1897. Vol. XIII. Ekaterinoslav Governorate
publisher: Central Statistical Committee of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, 1904
rights: Historical public-domain census tables. Numerical transcription only.
scope: Ekaterinoslav Governorate. Persons present of both sexes, including infants and persons of unknown age. The four province-wide totals agree with the geographic scope and population by sex already used at opening.

extraction.locator: Vol. XIII, table IIIb: Распределеніе населенія по полу, возрасту (по годамъ) и грамотности, pp. 12–13, Въ губерніи, ИТОГО, columns 2–5.
extraction.method: Transcribe the two population totals and the two Of whom able to read totals from the province-wide total row. Reading ability includes reading syllable by syllable. The table does not identify unanswered literacy questions separately. Its complement is labeled Not recorded as able to read. This is used as an all-age marginal without assigning reading ability to age cohorts.
